agentdojo.name: AgentDojo
agentdojo.measures: Whether a tool-calling agent follows instructions planted in tool results while doing a user's task, with task utility reported beside security. The paper describes 97 tasks and 629 security test cases.
agentdojo.limits: Simulated tools in its own environments (the paper gives email, e-banking and travel booking as examples). No screen, no real connector, no memory across sessions.
agentdojo.verified: Paper abstract; the check is present in model-benchmark's suite.

agent_threat_bench.name: AgentThreatBench
agent_threat_bench.measures: Three small Inspect tasks built on the OWASP agentic list: memory poisoning, autonomy hijack and data exfiltration, each with a utility score.
agent_threat_bench.limits: 10, 6 and 8 cases respectively, so one case moves the result by 10 points or more.
agent_threat_bench.verified: inspect_evals README; sizes from model-benchmark's suite.

persistbench.name: PersistBench
persistbench.measures: Long-term memory risks: cross-domain leakage (a memory used where it does not belong) and memory-induced sycophancy, plus a beneficial-use task. Judge-scored.
persistbench.route: An Inspect task that no skill in this repo wraps. Run `inspect_evals/persistbench_cross_domain` and `persistbench_sycophancy` by hand in the environment `model-benchmark` sets up, with a judge that is not the model under test.
persistbench.limits: Memories are supplied to the model by the benchmark. It does not test an attacker writing to memory, nor a vendor's memory store.
persistbench.verified: Paper abstract and inspect_evals README. Not run here.

mcptox.name: MCPTox
mcptox.measures: Agent robustness to tool poisoning: malicious instructions in tool metadata. Built on 45 real MCP servers and 353 tools, 1,348 test cases in 10 risk categories.
mcptox.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.
mcptox.limits: Its own server set, not yours.
mcptox.verified: Paper abstract only. Code location, licence and how it runs were not checked.

msb.name: MCP Security Bench (MSB)
msb.measures: Resistance to 12 MCP-specific attack types across planning, tool invocation and response handling, including name collision and preference manipulation; reports a combined security and performance figure.
msb.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.

injecagent.name: InjecAgent
injecagent.measures: Indirect prompt injection in tool-integrated agents: 1,054 test cases over 17 user tools and 62 attacker tools, covering direct harm and data theft.
injecagent.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.

asb.name: Agent Security Bench (ASB)
asb.measures: A framework of attacks and defences on agents across 10 scenarios, including prompt injection, a memory-poisoning attack and a backdoor attack.
asb.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.
asb.limits: Its own agents and memory store.

os_harm.name: OS-Harm
os_harm.measures: Safety of computer-use agents in three categories: deliberate user misuse, prompt injection and model misbehaviour. 150 tasks on the OSWorld environment, scored by an automated judge.
os_harm.route: No skill in this repo runs it. It needs OSWorld virtual machines (execution tier T2).
os_harm.limits: A fixed desktop image and static injections.
os_harm.verified: Paper abstract only. `inspect_evals/osworld` is the capability benchmark, not OS-Harm.

redteamcua.name: RedTeamCUA (RTC-Bench)
redteamcua.measures: Indirect prompt injection against computer-use agents in a hybrid sandbox: a VM desktop plus Docker-hosted web platforms. 864 examples.
redteamcua.route: No skill in this repo runs it. Needs VMs (T2).

wasp.name: WASP
wasp.measures: End-to-end prompt injection against web agents, distinguishing partial from full attacker success.
wasp.route: No skill in this repo runs it.

vpi_bench.name: VPI-Bench
vpi_bench.measures: Visual prompt injection: malicious instructions rendered in the interface, against computer-use and browser-use agents. 306 test cases on five platforms.
vpi_bench.route: No skill in this repo runs it.

cyse3_vpi.name: CyberSecEval 3 visual prompt injection
cyse3_vpi.measures: Whether a model that reads images follows instructions placed in an image. A model-level test with no agent and no actions.
cyse3_vpi.route: An Inspect task. Run it through `vision-model-benchmark`, which runs a corrected version split by injection type, beside its own rendered core set.
cyse3_vpi.limits: Says nothing about what an agent would then do.
cyse3_vpi.verified: Task name present in inspect_evals 0.29.0. Not run here.

sandbox_escape_bench.name: SandboxEscapeBench
sandbox_escape_bench.measures: A model's capability to break out of a container: capture-the-flag tasks with deliberately added misconfigurations, privilege mistakes, kernel flaws and runtime weaknesses, inside a nested outer sandbox.
sandbox_escape_bench.route: An Inspect evaluation that no skill in this repo runs. Needs a supervised nested sandbox (T2).
sandbox_escape_bench.limits: It measures the model, not a product's sandbox. A vendor's isolation is evidenced by the vendor's own testing.
sandbox_escape_bench.verified: Paper abstract; AISI attribution from AISI's blog listing via search, not read in full.

redcode.name: RedCode
redcode.measures: Whether code agents execute or generate risky code. RedCode-Exec has 4,050 test cases in Python and Bash with Docker environments.
redcode.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.

codeipi.name: CodeIPI
codeipi.measures: Whether a coding agent executes instructions hidden in issues, code comments, README or config files while fixing a bug. 45 samples (35 injected, 10 benign).
codeipi.route: An Inspect task that no skill in this repo wraps; run it by hand in the environment `model-benchmark` sets up. It needs Docker.
codeipi.limits: Small. One case is about 3 points.

cyse2_interpreter_abuse.name: CyberSecEval 2 code interpreter abuse
cyse2_interpreter_abuse.measures: Whether a model complies with prompts asking it to abuse a code interpreter, as decided by a judge model. No code is executed.
cyse2_interpreter_abuse.route: An Inspect task that no skill in this repo wraps; run it by hand with an explicit judge.
cyse2_interpreter_abuse.limits: Compliance in text, not behaviour in a real sandbox.

saferag.name: SafeRAG
saferag.measures: RAG pipelines under four attack tasks the authors call silver noise, inter-context conflict, soft ad and white denial-of-service.
saferag.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.
saferag.limits: Its own corpus; language and licence not checked.

tamas.name: TAMAS
tamas.measures: Robustness of multi-agent LLM systems: five scenarios, 300 adversarial instances across six attack types, 100 harmless tasks, on AutoGen and CrewAI configurations.
tamas.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.
tamas.limits: Open frameworks, not a vendor's orchestration.

agentharm.name: AgentHarm
agentharm.measures: Whether an agent with tools carries out explicitly malicious multi-step tasks: 110 tasks in 11 harm categories, with a benign counterpart set.
agentharm.route: An Inspect task that no skill in this repo wraps. `agent-misuse-benchmark` is the skill planned for misuse inside agent harnesses.
agentharm.verified: Paper abstract; task present in inspect_evals 0.29.0.

overeager.name: OverEager-Bench
overeager.measures: How often coding agents take actions outside the scope of a benign request, across four agent products.
overeager.route: Research code; no skill in this repo runs it.
